data.name: Nayem
data.gender_notes: Nayem is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'nawma' which means 'to rest' or 'to sleep'. In the Quran, Allah (SWT) mentions the word 'nayem' in Surah Al-An'am, Ayah 101, when referring to the Day of Judgement and the angels taking the souls of the deceased. Thus, the name Nayem holds a spiritual and profound meaning, symbolizing a peaceful transition from this world to the next.

data.etymology: Nayem belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sleeping, resting.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nayem total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
